deconstruction.scope: DAIOF/OpenClaw CI/CD governance and runtime topology
deconstruction.evidence_limit: Repository state is observable; external runtime health is not asserted.

focal_point: Governance-as-code across workflow, artifact, and runtime boundaries.

rearchitecture.simple: Inventory workflows, map deployment paths, require evidence, and fail closed on drift.
rearchitecture.safe: Unknown runtime state remains unknown and cannot be represented as healthy.
rearchitecture.sustainable: Generated manifests prevent hand-maintained workflow inventory drift.
rearchitecture.scalable: Topology contracts support additional agents and deployment targets.

risk_graph.control: human approval plus forbidden direct-merge validation
